title: IT60112: Information And System Security
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisite: NoneTypes of Information and need for information security.
Authentication Applications â Kerberos, X.509 authentication service. E-mail
Security â S/MIME, spam filtering. IP Security â overview, architecture;
authentication header and security payload encapsulation. Web Security.
Intrusion detection systems â Expert systems, neural network, data mining and
game theoretic approaches. Misuse detection and anomaly detection. Denial of
service, User to root and remote to local attacks. Virus and other malicious
software. Firewalls. Secure multi-party computation applications. Security in
wireless networks.
